description: Sponja connects the proposal, pricing, demo recording, and security documents your rep prepared for your specific deal directly to ChatGPT. Ask anything about your evaluation and get answers drawn only from those materials, with the source cited every time. When something is not covered, Sponja tells you instead of guessing and offers to flag it for your rep. You can also ask general questions about how Sponja works. Each connector is scoped to one buyer and one deal through a secure sign-in, so you only ever see your own materials. The first time you connect, a welcome card shows your deal snapshot and a few suggested questions, so you know right away what you can ask.
